chunks.content: 云鸊 K7 机柜现行维护规范 3.2。更换散热组件后，需在 38 分钟内完成第一次复检。只有散热组件更换才适用。
历史维护规范 3.1 曾规定更换散热组件后 83 分钟内复检。该版本自新版发布起作废。
现行维护规范 3.2。首次复检的工单类型为 K7-CHECK，适用于散热组件更换。柜门维护工单另有编号。
云鸊 K7 柜门更换线的工单编号为 K7-DOOR。接线检查的记录归档在二层设备间。
现行规范规定现场温度高于 42 摄氏度时暂停更换。手册没有提供停工后的具体重启时刻。
云鸊 K7 机柜 3.2 版复检完成后，使用验收标签 K7-PASS，并把纸质卡片插入绿色夹槽。
云鸊 K7 退役机柜的归档标签为 K7-RETIRE，不能作为复检凭证。
现行校准附录的控制测试需要在更换散热组件后记录压力差，但附件没有阈值参数。
更换前的开工申请需要等批准码 MAINT-OPEN。申请与复检是两项独立流程。
电池搬运箱在库房的 B4 区域，领用要登记库存条码。
白松山径秋季正式接驳手册，西坡入口到高台的末班车从西坡于 19:35 发车。雨天停驶，请看站口公告。
春季临时版本在西坡入口安排的末班车发车时间曾是 19:53。西坡秋季时刻由正式手册另行发布。
白松山径秋季正式版。西坡入口的末班接驳导向牌写有 PINE-LATE，放在检票入口左侧。
同站冬季检修期间引导标识为 PINE-OFF。维修起止日期见值班表。
雨天接驳停驶，运营方会按现场公告通知恢复时间。指南没有提供次日固定班次。
白松山径秋季西坡换乘核验码为 PINE-QR。在西坡到高台的接驳线路上有效。
白松山径秋季运营附录。东坡线路的换乘核验码为 EAST-QR。
西坡到高台秋季正式接驳的首次异常登记使用 ROUTE-LOG 表。附录不列车站标识。
白松山径秋季运营附录记录车站位置图。观景区风速预警以岗亭公告为准。
秋季西坡接驳运营费只在付款界面显示，纸质附录没有金额。
Current Kelp Bay dock manual, revision 6. Coastal-loading berths must check the hatch latch within 47 minutes of a pressure alert. This rule applies only to coastal loading.
Superseded revision 5 gave a 74 minute deadline for the coastal hatch latch after a pressure alert. Use revision 6 instead.
The coastal hatch-latch check is logged under HATCH-CHECK. It applies to the pressure-alert workflow in revision 6.
The inland storage bay uses label STORE-CHECK for its latch inspection. It has no operational authority at the dock.
After the coastal check, the gate remains locked until the supervisor sends release approval. Revision 6 does not specify a fixed maximum waiting time.
The Kelp Bay coastal exception annex, revision 6, uses approval form KELP-RELEASE after a supervisor approves reopening the gate.
The revision 5 emergency release record used BAY-OLD. This record is retired.
Maintenance employees report after-hours vehicle noise in the SHIFT-REPORT log. This annex gives no noise exposure limit.
Coastal dock teams operate the hatch latch as part of the pressure-alert workflow. The deadline is specified in the dock manual.
The supervisor escalation contact is listed in the regional directory. Review the directory before transferring records.
The Quartz Museum Q8 current energy saver exhibition opens at 09:42 on weekdays. This time applies to the east room only.
The retired trial schedule for the Q8 east room opened at 09:24 on weekdays. Trial visitors used a different room layout.
The current Q8 east room entry sign says QUARTZ-EAST. It is printed on the door directly below the weekday queue board.
The west room opens at 09:56 and provides separate group sessions. The west entry sign reads QUARTZ-WEST.
On power alerts the east room is closed. The handbook gives no fixed reopening time.
The Quartz Museum current Q8 east room uses Q8-ENTRY as the replacement booking code for customers who forgot their printed ticket.
The current Q8 west room replacement booking code is Q8-WEST. It is valid only at the west gate.
The trial Q8 east room code was Q8-OLD. It is now expired.
Booking staff enter damaged badge reports in the BADGE-LOG register. Give the badge to the hall attendant.
On power alerts refunds are recorded by the floor supervisor. The annex has no published compensation amount.
